dogecoin.text: @davidgokhshtein Genuine question. What is the purpose or use of dogecoin? If it has no genuine use, what is the reason for everyone buying it?

@CraigCharles23 In my opinion (I could be wrong) the only people promoting Dogecoin are those who have invested in it and want to make some money. I don’t think anyone will become rich overnight in crypto now, unless you’re day trading. But I would say ETH & LTC are two solid choices.
